userStories.title: Lifecycle regression evidence exports remain deterministic
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want lifecycle regression evidence exports to be deterministic so repeated runs remain auditable and stable.
acceptanceCriteria: Exported lifecycle evidence keeps deterministic ordering and identity linkage
Repeated export generation preserves machine-parsable parity semantics
No regression in existing lifecycle integrity semantics
researchTopics: Deterministic export contracts between lifecycle transition windows and release readiness artifact checks
Repeated-run assertion strategy for lifecycle evidence export parity across report and artifact surfaces
userStories.learnings: Deterministic lifecycle evidence export is strongest when it reuses ID-keyed parity contracts already used in release summary checks and constrains extraction to local transition windows. Repeated-run invariance should compare check_id keyed tuples and reason lists across report/artifact surfaces rather than relying on changelog index positions.
userStories.implementationNotes: Added deterministic export guard test in tests/unit/scripts/test_release_check_summary.py to assert repeated-run transition-window tuple identity and stable lifecycle parity rows/reason semantics across runs.
userStories.notes: Research report: .aha-loop/research/PRD-047-US-001-research.md; validation: 3 targeted tests passed including lifecycle export repeated-run parity guard.

userStories.title: Changelog/artifact parity drift is detected early
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want changelog-to-artifact parity drift to be detected early so lifecycle regressions cannot silently pass release evidence checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Parity drift between changelog lifecycle transitions and release artifact checks is deterministically detected
Missing or contradictory lifecycle evidence rows are surfaced by machine-verifiable guards
No regression in blocking decision reduction semantics
researchTopics: Failure scenarios where changelog lifecycle transitions and release artifact mappings diverge
Deterministic guard patterns for missing, mismatched, or contradictory parity rows
userStories.learnings: Early parity-drift detection is strongest when payload/artifact lifecycle evidence is compared by check_id with exact field equality, while reason-list parity is validated as an independent invariant.
userStories.implementationNotes: Added deterministic parity-drift test in tests/unit/scripts/test_release_check_summary.py that flags lifecycle drift when artifact-side lifecycle parity detail diverges from payload under otherwise stable rows.
userStories.notes: Research report: .aha-loop/research/PRD-047-US-002-research.md; validation: 3 targeted tests passed including lifecycle export parity drift detection guard.
